analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and corrects the source path for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED (base and head line 1816) from libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift. No executable code, config defaults, env passthrough lists, authorization or attestation behavior, or cache policy changes. The surrounding documentation in the supplied excerpts (LaunchAgent env passthrough, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE defaults, SSD cache write limits, App Attest worker flag) is unchanged context. It remains consistent with T-041 (encrypted SSD prefix cache, 30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup names) and TB-011 (App Attest worker candidate opt-in). I identified no security regression, new attack surface, or invalidated threat-model assumption. The new path claim was not verified against the actual source tree, since the source is not supplied. Its effect is documentation accuracy only. The head text excerpt is truncated at line 399, but the patch excerpt is complete and shows only these two line changes.
